meta.source: Badge states and copy: MarvinRidgeMT/Teens-Hack-Houston-Hackathon@4e7b1f1 (via Graphify). Look: MotionSites 'macOS widget' (Driftbar) design: paper, ink, lavender mist, blue-hour meadow, Inter.

color.note: Every text pair here is at least 4.5:1 and every control or icon pair at least 3:1, in both themes. State colours are deep in light (white glyph) and bright in dark (ink glyph).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: the setup page, the popup body. Driftbar's paper; in dark, the blue-hour night sky.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, prompts and panels that float over a page.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Lavender mist: the next-step box, selected rows, the fog band in templates. Ink on it 15.6:1 light, 13.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on paper, surface and mist.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Paragraphs, away time, tab count, captions. 5.9:1 or more on every background in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline outlines on cards and chips (Driftbar's chip border). Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries: inputs and quiet buttons. 3.3:1 light, 3.6:1 dark on surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view (Resume, Park, Save). Driftbar's black button; it inverts at blue hour.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on accent. 19.6:1 light, 17.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Brand hue from the blue-hour sky: links, the active task name, the brand mark. 7.2:1 light, 8.3:1 dark on surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, offset 2px, on every control.

tokens.name: state-parked
tokens.usage: Badge 'P': a task is parked. Same family as periwinkle. Replaces the repo's #0D9488.

tokens.name: state-away
tokens.usage: Badge '•': you are away. Warm firefly amber. Replaces #D97706, which failed with white text.

tokens.name: state-wrapped
tokens.usage: Badge '☾': wrapped up for today. Dusk violet. Replaces #4F46E5.

tokens.name: state-saved
tokens.usage: Badge flash '✓' and the live dot on chips. Keeps the repo's #15803D in light.

tokens.name: state-neutral
tokens.usage: Badge flash '!' and '?': nothing saved, no task yet.

tokens.name: on-state
tokens.usage: The glyph on any state colour. 5:1 or more on every state in both themes.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The frosted-glass 'Pickup' wordmark in the setup page footer. Decorative, aria-hidden.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Pick up right where you left off

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Task name on cards; section titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Column and group titles, prompt titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Finish the paragraph on the 1836 convention.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Shortcut hints: Alt+P, Alt+R, Alt+V, Enter, T, Esc.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to key hint.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card offset from the page corner; rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between list items in footer columns; popup padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Setup page section gaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Key caps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the brand tile (Driftbar's 8px tile).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, prompts, the popup.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, the brand tile's inner pill.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Anything floating over a website: return card, park prompt, toast.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: The brand tile.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press, hover lift, exits.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Card and prompt enter; chip and toast enter.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Highlight pulse after Resume; template section reveal.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between children revealing: Motion.stagger(0.04).

easing.note: Pass to Motion as a 4-number array, or use a spring.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: CSS stand-in for Motion's { type: 'spring', bounce: 0.3, duration: 0.45 }: badge pops, the saved check, chips.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Return card, park prompt and toast, injected into any page.
